questions.question: Verify the institutional chronology: the source gives Vyatka from 1917 and the Pokrovsky institute, later Herzen, for 1925–1970. Herzen University’s museum gives Vyatka from 1918 and distinguishes Herzen work from a part-time Pokrovsky professorship from 1947, https://www.herzen.spb.ru/about/struct-uni/other-podr/muzey/znamenatelnye-daty/ . Approve both versions.

questions.question: Clarify A History of Mathematics (1959): this may be the first edition of A History of Arithmetic, reissued in 1965. The historians’ reference book identifies A History of Arithmetic (1959), https://www.mathsoc.spb.ru/history/Ist_mat_spravochnik.pdf . Verify the title and approve both versions.

questions.question: Approve the author’s initials for Russia’s Gift to the World: the Russian source has D. V. Mackail, while the 1915 English edition’s catalogue gives J. W. (John William) Mackail, https://ci.nii.ac.jp/ncid/BA21489569 . The English version uses the established English name; the Russian initials await an editorial decision.
